name: integration-full
description: Canonical end-to-end SDK contract fixture covering metadata-only control-plane, detached signature, envelope, TDF, rewrap, artifact registration, and evidence ingestion.
subject: spiffe://lattix.test/sdk-contract-runner
plaintext_utf8: Integration full scenario plaintext for SDK contract validation.

steps.name: capabilities
steps.description: Read SDK capability metadata and auth configuration.

steps.name: bootstrap
steps.description: Fetch bootstrap metadata for local enforcement.

steps.name: prepare_local_protection
steps.description: Prepare local protection state for envelope artifacts.

steps.name: generate_cid_binding
steps.description: Generate the content identifier binding for the plaintext.

steps.name: protection_plan
steps.description: Request a protection plan for the TDF artifact path.

steps.name: policy_resolve
steps.description: Resolve platform policy for protection operations.

steps.name: key_access_plan
steps.description: Request authorization guidance for managed key transport.

steps.name: detached_signature_round_trip
steps.description: Sign and verify detached-signature artifacts locally.

steps.name: envelope_round_trip
steps.description: Protect and access an envelope artifact using managed keys.

steps.name: envelope_rewrap
steps.description: Rewrap the envelope artifact from the current to the rewrap key.

steps.name: tdf_round_trip
steps.description: Protect and access a TDF artifact using managed keys.

steps.name: tdf_rewrap
steps.description: Rewrap the TDF artifact to a new managed key reference.

steps.name: artifact_register_direct
steps.description: Register the rewrapped artifact through the direct SDK call.

steps.name: evidence_direct
steps.description: Submit rewrap evidence through the direct SDK call.
